# Project Overview

This project is a C-based air quality monitoring system. It includes source code for reading sensor data, processing it, and generating alerts based on air quality thresholds.

## Project Structure

The project is organized as follows:

- `air_quality/HLR.md`: Contains high-level requirements for the project.
- `air_quality/LLR.md`: Contains low-level requirements for the project.
- `air_quality/code-standard.md`: Contains the coding standards for the project.
- `air_quality/src/`: Contains the source code of the air quality monitoring system.

## Coding Standards
The coding standards for this project are defined in the `air_quality/code-standard.md` file. All source code should adhere to these standards to ensure consistency and maintainability across the project.

## High-Level Requirements (HLR)

The high-level requirements for the air quality monitoring system are documented in the `air_quality/HLR.md` file. This file outlines the overall objectives, system functionalities, and key performance criteria that the system must meet.

## Low-Level Requirements (LLR)

The low-level requirements for the air quality monitoring system are documented in the `air_quality/LLR.md` file. This file provides detailed specifications for the system components, interfaces, and implementation details necessary to meet the high-level requirements.
